label: General advice
help_now_steps: Do not pay or share codes or passwords.
Hang up or close the chat.
Call your bank using the number printed on your card.

who_to_contact.name: Your bank
who_to_contact.how: Use the phone number printed on the back of your bank card. Do not use a number from the message or call.

who_to_contact.name: A trusted family member or neighbour
who_to_contact.how: Tell them what happened before you send money or share codes.

who_to_contact.name: FTC ReportFraud (United States)
who_to_contact.how: Report the scam online, or call the FTC help line.
